lead_raw_text:
The structure of K₄Rb₈Te₄ (K(Rb₂Te)₂) crystallizes in the cubic space group Fm-3m (No. 225), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives each K and Te center 8 Rb neighbors and each Rb center 4 K and 4 Te neighbors, all described as a body-centered-cubic-like local arrangement with a uniform neighbor distance of 3.5806 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include Rb–Rb corner, edge, and face sharing, while K–Rb and Te–Rb pairs show corner and face sharing.
